skills.name: Third-Party Script Performance Optimization
skills.description: Quick-start workflow to set up a new Maven project from scratch, covering project structure, archetype selection, and initial configuration within 5–30 minutes.
skills.skill_body:
Follow the Maven Getting Started guides to initialize a new project. Select an appropriate archetype, apply it to create the standard directory layout, and verify the pom.xml is correctly generated and ready for build.

## Objective

Initialize and configure a Maven project ready for build
## Applicable Signals

- Starting a new Maven project
- Onboarding a developer to Maven basics
- Need to establish standard project structure

## Contraindications

- Modifying an existing project's build configuration
- Troubleshooting build failures
- Adjusting dependency management in an active project

## Workflow Steps

- Select or identify an appropriate Maven archetype for the project type
- Apply the archetype to generate the project skeleton
- Verify standard directory layout is created (src/main/java, src/test/java, etc.)
- Review and validate the generated pom.xml
- Confirm project is ready for initial build

## Constraints

- Archetype selection must match intended project type
- Standard directory layout must be preserved
- pom.xml must be syntactically valid before handoff

## Output Contract

- A Maven project with standard directory layout, pom.xml, and verified archetype applied; project is ready for dependency declaration and build execution
